rounds.name: Boss is Here
rounds.desc: Udon got beat by you and ran away saying "Someone will defeat you". Not too long

rounds.name: Graduation
rounds.desc: After the Konohamaru and his followed were subdued the graduation ceremony of shinobi school started. Many young shinobi is waiting here for their titles.

rounds.name: Trouble
rounds.desc: The shinobis around you were irritated by your slovenly attitude. While you were staring at Sakura someone couldn't help but stand out to say:"What are you looking at"

rounds.name: Eye to Eye
rounds.desc: The shinobis of your class came forward but defeated only to make more feel pissed. As more people gathered

rounds.name: Just Look
rounds.desc: After beating another two you said "I'm the No.1 in this class" and stared at Sakura provocatively.

rounds.name: Fate
rounds.desc: Damn, I won't forgive you that you are bold to look at her so long. Another boy with yellow hair stood out who is named Naruto Uzumaki.

rounds.name: Interest
rounds.desc: Given several rounds of competition with any insidious moves

rounds.name: Men's Fight
rounds.desc: Naruto Uzumaki and you took it seriously with respect. This is what men do when they meet another man defeating him.

rounds.name: Angry Beauty
rounds.desc: In the end you reached a draw game with Naruto and left together like old friends. "Darn" ignore me.

rounds.name: Kill Spred
rounds.desc: Talking louder and louder with Naruto you stepped on a weird folk

rounds.name: Be Mad
rounds.desc: What are you staring at? Take it back, or I will get your eye out! Right? Naruto? "Errr" "What? Naruto? Does this dude have some troubles with you? Let me punish him for you."

rounds.name: Remember
rounds.desc: You are so annoying. Sasuke Uchiha stood up and walk toward you with several other "Sasuke". "Colone Technique? I can do it too."

rounds.name: First Fight
rounds.desc: Both you and Sasuke used Colone Technique to compete with each other one on on. In fact you are competing for who has more Chakra.

rounds.name: Taunted
rounds.desc: Two dummies, how dare you to make noise in my class. Don't you want to graduate? A cool shinobi said in contempt while watching the fight between you and Sasuke.

rounds.name: Masked Man
rounds.desc: What? Look down on me? I will be the Hokage, hahaha "Idiot can you just stop for a little bit?" Sasuke

rounds.name: Real Ninja
rounds.desc: Kakashi Hatake instructed a shinobi who nodded his head and appeared between Sasuke and you to separate you. "What?" You couldn't believe it that a strike with all your power

rounds.name: Graduate
rounds.desc: Noticing that the strike with all your power is stopped easily Sasuke and you stopped and returned your own seat

rounds.name: Unqualified
rounds.desc: But none of you desert the title of shinobi yet. Later you will be divided into teams. A real shinobi will lead you and only the successor can be real shinobi.

rounds.name: A Team
rounds.desc: Senju Avatar, Uzumaki Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura, the four of you are in my team. Kakashi Hatake pointed at you and other three with a wicked smile.

rounds.name: Happy?
rounds.desc: It was great to be with Naruto but not a good news to be with Sasuke. Horrible.

rounds.name: True Love
rounds.desc: Well, god bless me. Avatar, I and Sakura are in one team! Seeing that Naruto falls into delusion you realized who he loves.

rounds.name: Love You
rounds.desc: You turned to Sakura and felt this girl is not charming at all. But you noticed she lays all her attention on Sasuke. Now it seems to be a play!

rounds.name: Hate You
rounds.desc: Sasuke, we are in the same team, nice to meet you. Sakura walked toward Sasuke shyly. Dissatisfaction appeared on his face.

rounds.name: Tomorrow
rounds.desc: You, remember to show yourself at the back mountain 10 am tomorrow! Anyone who is late will be considered a failure. Kakashi turned around and said.

rounds.name: Love Ramen
rounds.desc: Let's go, Naruto, let me treat you with ramen. You patted at Naruto's shoulder. The word "ramen" cheered Naruto up immediately "OK

rounds.name: Beat Sasuke
rounds.desc: After a bowl of ramen Naruto asked you to beat Sasuke with him. A bunch of terrible ideas come to your ear from Naruto.

rounds.name: Ambush
rounds.desc: Sasuke walked along depressed "It seems he has some worries in his mind." "Whatever

rounds.name: Shapshift
rounds.desc: Naruto transformed into Sasuke and walked to Sakura on the rock. Sakura looked up and saw "Sasuke" "What are you doing here." Sasuke

rounds.name: Unavailable
rounds.desc: Standing aside you deemed how obscene Naruto is. On the other side

rounds.name: Go on!
rounds.desc: Why you give up? "I will let her fall in love with the real me. I have to be the strongest shinobi!" Naruto Uzumaki waved his fist.

rounds.desc: The second day 11 am.

rounds.name: You are Late

rounds.desc: Gaara looks at the C3 Bomb and recalls the recent huge explosion. "Sand Grave!" He uses his power to lift the C3 Bomb. "Bang!" - it explodes with a huge boom. "Master Gaara has saved me."

rounds.name: Follow-up
rounds.desc: Do you think this can stop me? Don't underestimate me! Let's blow some more! Deidara gives you a sinister glance. "Damn!" Gaara is transporting the explosives outside the village.

rounds.name: Take Gaara
rounds.desc: Gaara has spent much energy to subdue Deidara's explosion so the exploding bomb makes him dizzy. "That's inconvenient

rounds.name: Chase Up
rounds.desc: That's not good. Gaara was taken. I will chase them! Kankurō sees Gaara being taken away and immediately gives chase. "Kankurō

rounds.name: Sasori
rounds.desc: Kankurō chases until the gate to Sunagakure village. "What?! You are Sasori?" "Kankurō! Long time no see! Do you remember me?" A huge mechanical Puppet arrives emitting a buzzing sound.

rounds.name: Puppet Fight
rounds.desc: Let Gaara go! Sasori! - yells Kankurō. "Don't worry too much! The supreme order is kidnapping Jinchūrikis." "So we must fight!" Kankurō releases a Puppet.

rounds.name: Just toys
rounds.desc: Black Ant! "Salamander!" "Raven!" - Kankurō summons his puppets preparing for battle. "They look like my old toys!" - cackles Sasori of the Red Sand.

rounds.name: Urgent
rounds.desc: Sunagakure village can't prevail over such great problems. Everyone has been captured. "Quick inform Konohagakure and ask them for help!" - orders Baki.

rounds.name: Poisoned
rounds.desc: Kankurō and Sasori of the Red Sand fight for a few rounds. Raven Salamander and Black Ant have all been destroyed

rounds.name: Rescue Team
rounds.desc: Avatar, Naruto, Sakura, Kakashi, Sunagakure is under Akatsuki attack! Gaara has been captured. Help them asap! - orders Godaime Tsunade. "Yes!"

rounds.name: Presbyter
rounds.desc: Kankurō is poisoned. If he doesn't receive treatment soon, he's in trouble. Go and fetch the two elders. Baki sends someone to bring Ebizō and Senju from Sunagakure. They are the only ones.

rounds.name: Helpless
rounds.desc: Kankurō is poisoned and I can't help. Only princess Tsunade can save her. However, Konohagakure can't send anything important away. Senju shakes her head. She is good at poisoning others but not expert at curing poisons.

rounds.name: Rescue
rounds.desc: Finally here! Gaara, you must wait for me! I will save you! Naruto has great feelings for Gaara as they have faced much together ever since childhood.

rounds.name: Sakura In
rounds.desc: It's those kids. "Have you any doctor shinobi? Kankurō is poisoned and requires help." "Let me see I am apprentice of master Tsunade." Sakura arrives.

rounds.name: Save
rounds.desc: Prepare those herbs for me. This poison can be cured. - says Sakura." "Great! Kankurō will be healed." Grandmother Chiyo looks at Sakura and rejoices.

rounds.name: Chase Sasori
rounds.desc: Kankurō is saved and you must chase Sasori of the Red Sand. It is already late and Gaara might still die. "I will go with you. Sasori of the Red Sand is my grandson." Grandmother Senju wants to join you.

rounds.name: Tear Apart
rounds.desc: Akatsuki has already used the Tailed Beast Technique on Gaara who shouldn't be disturbed. Itachi and Kisame use their Puppet clones to intercept you on your way.

rounds.name: Confront
rounds.desc: Led by Kakashi's tracking dog you are approaching your targets. You join another shinobi which was sent to reinforce you - it's Gai! "Long time no see!" Suddenly

rounds.name: Genjutsu
rounds.desc: Don't look into Itachi's eyes, or you will be sucked into his Genjutsu! - warns Kakashi. He knows Mangekyō Sharingan powers all too well. "When it comes to Genjutsu teamwork is more important !"

rounds.name: Hold&fight
rounds.desc: Grandmother Senju tells you that when fighting against Genjutsu a group of fighters should not fear anything. When one is hit

rounds.name: Kisame&Gai
rounds.desc: Leave Gai to me. i want to have revenge for the last time! Kisame raises the Samehada blade and attacks Gai. Gai scratches hi shead and looks at Kisame: "Who are you?" "Damn you!"

rounds.name: Armors
rounds.desc: Kisame approaches with his Ninjutsu shark bite and Gai feels enormous pressure. "Eight Gates Released Formation - Open the sixth gate!" "What? You're so fast!" Now

rounds.name: Peacock
rounds.desc: Susume! - Gai uses his unique Suzume surrounding Kisame with mighty power. "It's over. This time

rounds.name: Genjutsu
rounds.desc: You and Naruto attack on the flanks while in the center Kakashi uses Sharingan to dodge Itachi's Genjutsu. "Rasengan!" Both of you use Rasengan to charge against Itachi. "Damn

rounds.name: All matured
rounds.desc: If you hit Genjutsu how can it be Shadow Clone Technique? "You two are quite good. If you are hit with Genjutsu

rounds.name: VS Itachi
rounds.desc: Katon - Great Fireball Technique! Itachi launches attack. "Tsukuyomi!" Just when Itachi is launching his attack Kakashi rapisly uses his Shadow Clone Technique

rounds.name: Destory All
rounds.desc: Avatar, Naruto and my clone will die together! - yells Kakashi. You are waiting for an opportunity. "Big Ball Rasengan!" Grandmother Chiyo and Sakura are shocked to see your Big Ball Rasengan.

rounds.name: It's a Clone
rounds.desc: Kisame and Itachi perish in the explosion. "No! They're only scapegoats! Such a strange Ninjutsu." "It is the power of our village. In fact they're spies." - says Grandmother Chiyo.

rounds.name: Jinchūriki
rounds.desc: What are Tailed Beasts? - asks Sakura. "They are powerful Chakra beasts with a tail and symbols of power. Also

rounds.name: Naruto&Avatar
rounds.desc: Naruto has a Kyubi sealed within him, so he is Kyubi's Jinchūriki. But Avatar is really strange. His body contains great power, but it's not a Tailed Beast. - says Kakashi.

rounds.name: 5-seal Sphere
rounds.desc: Finally! I can feel Gaara behind this rock, but this place is sealed. - says the ninja tracker. "This is the five-seal boundary. We must find five seal Tags Neji

rounds.name: Unlocked
rounds.desc: With the help of Neji's Byakugan you open the five-seal boundary

rounds.name: Kill You
rounds.desc: Gaara, what are you doing? Stand up! - shouts Naruto. "Fool! Don't you know he's not sleeping? He is dead! Hahaha!" - laughs Deidara. "I will kill you!"

rounds.name: What is Art
rounds.desc: Brother Sasori, leave him to me. Let him taste my art. - says Deidara. "Deidara don't be too aggressive. Your art is beautiful

rounds.name: Take off
rounds.desc: Swallow him! We're leaving! Deidara instructs his Puppet bird to swallow Gaara and flies away. "Damn! After him! We can't let him escape!"

rounds.name: Split
rounds.desc: Naruto, you and I will chase Deidara. Avatar, Sakura - you stay and fight Sasori. Let's separate now! - Kakashi gives commands. "I will stay and confront Sasori. He is my grandson.

rounds.name: Collect
rounds.desc: Sakura looks into Sasori's eyes and realizes her real battle experience is nowhere near his. You throw a few Shurikens but they're all blocked. "Since you choose to resist me

rounds.name: Cruel one
rounds.desc: That's not his body, it's just his Puppet. He flays a human skin, dries it up, and pulls it over a mechanic device. He is just hiding behind this image. - says Grandmother Chiyo. "Grandma you really want to die!"

rounds.name: Charge
rounds.desc: You must open up the Puppet to catch him. "Grandmother Chiyo control Sakura to smash his shell. I will pin him down!" "Careful! His every attack is poisoned!"

rounds.name: Crack zhell
rounds.desc: Multiple Shadow Clone Technique! The entire cave fills with your clones who launch attacks against Sasori. "I must watch out for his Rasengan

rounds.name: Here!Sasori
rounds.desc: Damn! Die you old crone! Sasori's Puppet is broken exposing his body. "You really think this can defeat me? Let me show you my favorite collection item!"

rounds.name: 3rd Kazekage
rounds.desc: What? The Third Kazekage, killed by you? You traitor! Grandmother Chiyo looks at Sasori's treasure and bursts in rage. "Killing him cost me a lot of effort."

rounds.name: Goal: Sakura
rounds.desc: Sasori of the Red Sand uses the Third Kazekage. It's his most powerful Puppet armed from head to foot. "Come! Myriad Iron Hand!" "Chakra Shield!" You see Sakura in danger

rounds.name: Powerful
rounds.desc: What? Such powerful Chakra, able to resist my attack? Who are you? Sasori of the Red Sand doesn't believe it. "The Senju clan Senju Avatar."

rounds.name: Dance of Iron Sand
rounds.desc: In that case, come! Most powerful form! Iron Sand Drizzle! Sasori of the Red Sand uses his most powerful form. "Stay away! The power of Third Kazekage is great. If you're hit it's over!"

rounds.name: Fly Rasengan
rounds.desc: Stay back! Flying Rasengan! You use your own Ninjutsu Flying Rasengan

rounds.name: Iron Sand Boundary
rounds.desc: Sasori of the Red Sand uses Iron Sand Boundary to stop your Rasengan. At the same time he uses a powerfull attack of the Third Kazekage. "Stay out

rounds.name: Combo
rounds.desc: Well, it seems we have a draw. Rasengan Combo! You use a Rasengan Combo attacking with countless Rasengans

rounds.name: 100 Puppet
rounds.desc: That's pretty powerful. I'm really losing face here. I've been playing with you for so long and you're still standing. Performance of a Hundred Puppets!

rounds.name: Termination
rounds.desc: Now that's too much trouble. My teacher doesn't allow me to use this technique, but now I have no choice. Watch me! Swallowing Technique - Total Annihilation!

rounds.name: Side effect
rounds.desc: Having used a prohibited technique you feel unusually weak. This technique costs much life force. "Powerful Technique!" Grandmother Chiyo is looking at you.

rounds.name: Eye Tech
rounds.desc: Teacher, this guy is in the air now. How can we bring him down? Naruto has been chasing him far but as Deidara is in the sky

rounds.name: Lost Control
rounds.desc: Damn, I have no control. I still haven't gotten used to this new technique. Kakashi can't fully control Sharingan's new technique yet so it's a little weird. However

rounds.name: Save Gaara
rounds.desc: Rasenshuriken! Naruto chops off a wing of Deidara's bird. Later he grabs Deidara with both hands and pulls him out of the bird's clay belly. Seeing the dead Gaara

rounds.name: Shadow Clone Shuriken
rounds.desc: Berserk Naruto transforms into the power of Kyubi's three-tail. His will is already weakened. "Is that Kyubi's Jinchūriki's power?" "Shadow Clone Technique Shuriken!"

rounds.name: Ultimate Art
rounds.desc: Damn, You underestimate Deidara! Let me show you my power! Ultimate technique - C4 Bomb. Deidara is mad and transforms into a bomb. "Mangekyō Sharingan!"

rounds.name: Space-time
rounds.desc: Kakashi's eye technique is a space-time Ninjutsu. It can move objects into certain space. He moves the explosion into some other small place effectively nullifying the ultimate technique.

rounds.name: Revive Spell
rounds.desc: Seeing Gaara Naruto holds his haid in pain. "Why?! You pathetic scum! There are more who will oppose you!" "Naruto

rounds.name: Revive Gaara
rounds.desc: Grandmother Chiyo uses her own life force to resurrect Gaara. "Grandmother Chiyo!" "It doesn't matter. Our generation believed themselves to be very smart but we made many errors.

rounds.name: New life
rounds.desc: Grandmother Chiyo spends her own life force to resurrect Gaara. KazeKage will lead the Sunagakure village pursuing peace and stability. "Naruto

rounds.name: Value Info
rounds.desc: Sasori of the Red Sand facing his own death

rounds.name: New member
rounds.desc: Danzō Shimura is Konohagakure's hawk faction. He sends one of his followers a man called "Sai" to join Kakashi's team. Go and learn some info on Orochimaru and Sasuke.

rounds.name: Friend
rounds.desc: You and Naruto take a stroll in the village. You don't know how your old companions fare after those two years. Shino Aburame Kiba Inuzuka

rounds.name: Drawing
rounds.desc: Sai uses Beast Picture Ninja Art to communicate with you. Many tigers and other beasts run up to you. "Naruto attack!" You and Naruto separate

rounds.name: Do Tasks
rounds.desc: Konohagakure advisors don't want Naruto to join the operations because Akatsuki has captured Jinchūriki. But Tsunade believes that Naruto gives people a warm feeling

rounds.name: New Leader
rounds.desc: Kakashi has used a new technique so he's been lying in the hospital for the last few days. The time to meet with Orochimaru's spy is coming near

rounds.name: New teammate
rounds.desc: Teacher Kakashi doesn't feel well, so this time, you'll be under the command of Yamato. This is another member of your team. He's called Sai. i hope you can complete this mission.

rounds.name: Unsatisfied
rounds.desc: Although he looks like Sasuke, but his face is deprived of any emotions. It troubles me. - says Naruto. You and Sakura nod your heads. Indeed it doesn't look good.

rounds.name: Sakura Move
rounds.desc: Naruto and Sai argue along the way. "Sasuke is that traitor to Konohagakure who follows Orochimaru? He was your teammate?" "Bang!"

rounds.name: 4 Pillars
rounds.desc: Mokuten - Four Pillars Technique! You bicker again? I will fix you! - says leader Yamato. You notice that Yamato can use Mokuten which is Syodaime Ninjutsu.

rounds.name: Practice
rounds.desc: To smooth out the differences between the teammates leader Yamato decides to train you cooperation. "Avatar

rounds.name: Understand
rounds.desc: Sai and Naruto face Yamato. Naruto grabs Yamato and Sai uses beast Ninja Art. the two men are tied together and soon after the real Yamato is captured. "Sai

rounds.name: For Sasuke
rounds.desc: Sai has no feelings and he has never felt anything to anyone

rounds.name: Fake Sasori
rounds.desc: Captain Yamato has prepared a battle plan and transforms into a scorpion and hides at the top of the sky bridge. "Rustle-rustle." "You have come! Have you got all the info I need?"

rounds.name: It's Kabuto
rounds.desc: What? That's Kabuto! You all hide at a distance but when the spy removes his mask

rounds.name: Orochimaru
rounds.desc: Yamato is having a talk with Kabuto. Suddenly Yamato tries to catch Kabuto

rounds.name: Thank Him
rounds.desc: Thank you Sasori. If it was not for your plan, he wouldn't come here, and I wouldn't achieve my plans so smoothly. Before, I needed 100 bodies, but now, only 10!

rounds.name: Sudden Kill
rounds.desc: While Yamato is listening to Orochimaru Kabuto suddenly turns around and cuts with a Chakra Blade. Yamato

rounds.name: Fake Sasori
rounds.desc: Hidden Shadow Snake Hands! "Wood Escape - Body Replacement Technique." Yamato uses Body Replacement Technique to counter Orochimaru's multi-snake attacks. "So that's you! Why don't you call those four little rats behind you?”

rounds.name: Found Out
rounds.desc: I didn't expect we'd be discovered! Attack! You all charge together. "Oh! I recognize many of them. Even the Kyubi guy and the Senju clan's Avatar are here." - says Kabuto.

rounds.name: Free Sasuke
rounds.desc: Orochimaru, you bastsrd! Give Sasuke back! Naruto doesn't understand why he's so unstable and his Chakra flows out of his body. "Not good I'm changing into Tailed Beast."

rounds.name: Subject
rounds.desc: I never expected to I'd be fighting against my one-time experimental body, Yamato. Long time ago Yamato was Orochimaru's childhood experimental body for Syodaime Hashirama Senju.

rounds.name: Ourburst
rounds.desc: Everybody fall back! Master said Naruto is unstable! That's terrible! You send everyone back and Naruto continues towards Kabuto and Orochimaru alone. "Fuck!" Kabuto charges at him.

rounds.name: Not Enough
rounds.desc: Go to hell! Naruto slams Kabuto. "Did you think you'd use Chakra and send me flying in the air?! Jinchūriki you didn't think it over." Orochimaru looks at Naruto and says: "That's all your power?"

rounds.name: 4-tail Appear
rounds.desc: If that's all you can, you are still far from Sasuke. Orochimaru's words trigger another transformation of Naruto and he grows the fourth tail. "Die!"

rounds.name: Bullet
rounds.desc: Naruto swallows huge amount of Chakra and spits it out of Kyubi's mouth. "If you're hit by this Chakra bullet

rounds.name: Kusanagi
rounds.desc: Orochimaru appears when Naruto finishes creating the Chakra bullet. "Sword of Kusanagi! Damn! How come it can't cut through? It's the sharpest blade there is!"

rounds.name: Naruto
rounds.desc: Not good! Avatar, if Naruto continues like this, his consciousness will disappear. We must stop Naruto. - says captain Yamato. "Fine!" Sai looks at Orochimaru.

rounds.name: Recovery
rounds.desc: Mokuten - Wood Locking Wall. Mokuten - Wood Binding. Yamato puts the transformed Naruto to sleep. "Avatar attack!" You see that Yamato has put Naruto to sleep.

rounds.name: Retreat
rounds.desc: Damn, the time has come. This body is not good enough. I must get Sasuke's body! Orochimaru is hobbling away supported by Kabuto.

rounds.name: Danzō Mail
rounds.desc: Super-beast picture! Sai uses Ninja Art and gives chase. "Are you looking for death?" Orochimaru stares at Sai. "No! This is the message from master Danzō."

rounds.name: Sai's Book
rounds.desc: Sai follows Orochimaru and only you are left behind. "What's this? Sai's picture album." Sakura looks at the album. "Strange. All the pictures inside display fight against various people."

rounds.name: Last One
rounds.desc: the last picture shows two people shaking hands and smiling. Is that guy Sai's older brother? Sakura closes the album. "Let's go. We must chase Orochimaru and bring Sasuke back."

rounds.name: Yamato Move
rounds.desc: They have gone, Sai has gone. We can't follow them. - says distressed Naruto. "It's nothing. I hid a special seal in Sai's clothes. We just need to follow the seal." - says Yamato.

rounds.name: Find Place
rounds.desc: The four of you rush after Yamato's seal until you reach the foot of a huge mountain. "If we didn’t guess wrong

rounds.name: Enter
rounds.desc: Watch me break this stone! Enter! Naruto wants to use Rasengan but Yamato stops him. "If you use it Orochimaru will discover us. Better use Mokuten."

rounds.name: Found Sai
rounds.desc: Following the trails left by captain Yamato you quickly find Sai's location. "As an Anbu master

rounds.name: Sai's Target
rounds.desc: As soon as I saw you, my mission failed. Sai speaks and smiles. "Was it Danzō who let you connect with Orochimaru and destroy Konohagakure?" "Yes."

rounds.name: More
rounds.desc: Not only that. I was also a spy. I bring info on Orochimaru to master Danzō. - says Sai. "Damn! How could you! You collaborate with strangers!" - Naruto grows angry.

rounds.name: Be Quiet
rounds.desc: If you don't want to be discovered, you should go! Sai spreads his arms in a carefree manner driving Naruto into greater rage. Yamato orders you to bind Sai

rounds.name: Come! Kabuto
rounds.desc: I didn't expect you'd find this place. Sai, you've been captured! But still, you deserve my trust. Kabuto has suddenly appeared in the room. "Damn! Let me destroy you! Rasengan!

rounds.name: Changed Sai
rounds.desc: It's no use. Your Rasengan can't hit me. Kabuto dodges attacks with lightning speed but Sai grabs him from behind. "Sai

rounds.name: Destiny?
rounds.desc: I want to see the connection between you and Sasuke, why you can risk so much for him. - says Sai to Naruto. He is curious - what kind of emotion can make people so attached to each other?

rounds.name: Find Sasuke
rounds.desc: You are searching room by room but to no avail. "Festival

rounds.name: Leave you
rounds.desc: You too are watching Orochimaru cautiously. After all it's a dangerous person. "Flying Rasengan!" You attack with a Rasengan

rounds.name: Mice Troop
rounds.desc: This place is full of rooms - searching them one by one takes ages and you don't know when you will find him. "Beast Human Clone

rounds.name: Kill you
rounds.desc: Who dares disturb my sleep? Are you looking for death? Sasuke turns around and stares at Sai. "i wanted to kill you but I'm curious why he is so attached to you.

rounds.name: Sasuke Kill
rounds.desc: It's Sasuke's Chakra! Go - over there! You Naruto

rounds.name: Meet Again
rounds.desc: Sasuke! After many years you finally see Sasuke again. You are all very moved. "Sasuke

rounds.name: New Destiny
rounds.desc: Sasuke looks at you and says: "Long time no see! Why did you even bother to try and bring me back? I have a new goal - to defeat my older brother! Your goals mean nothing to me now!"

rounds.name: Challenge
rounds.desc: Naruto, step aside! Your power is not enough! Avatar, come! I always wanted to challenge you. Sasuke points his Sword of Kusanagi at you issuing a challenge.

rounds.name: Final Sasuke
rounds.desc: It seems we must defeat you to bring you back. You advance watching Sasuke. "In fact

rounds.name: Let's fight!
rounds.desc: Orochimaru arrives as well and stares at you. "This Avatar is odd. I can't see through his powers." - says Orochimaru to himself. "Flying Rasengan Pursuit Bullet!"

rounds.name: Request
rounds.desc: Sasuke stares at the incoming Rasengan and dodges it with one jump. "His speed is so fast! Avatar will not defeat Sasuke." "Brother Avatar

rounds.name: Surpass
rounds.desc: Naruto looks at Avatar with an envious look. Avatar's power has grown the most. Naruto puffs: "I will surpass Brother Avatar!"

rounds.name: Unique Spell
rounds.desc: just when Sasuke thinks he can avoid the Rasengan it extends and flies towards his back. "What?! This Rasengan can extend so much?!" "That's why it's called Pursuit Rasengan."

rounds.name: Sasuke Hit
rounds.desc: Bang! Rasengan slams Sasuke pushing him into the rock wall. Just when everyone thinks it's over

rounds.name: Explosive Rasengan
rounds.desc: Exploding Pursuit Rasengan Combo! Without opening your mouth you throw countless Rasengan with the move of your hand. Sasuke blocks them with his Sword of Kusanagi. "Damn

rounds.name: True Fight
rounds.desc: Sasuke can't retreat from Rasengan any further his hand holding the Sword of Kusanagi is already shaking. "You really piss me off! Second form! Chidori!"

rounds.name: Reflection
rounds.desc: Sasuke runs toward you. The mighty powers of the Chidori held in his hands have turned it black. "Go to hell!" Sasuke desires to destroy you. "Chakra Reflecting Shield!"

rounds.name: Sicked Avatar
rounds.desc: Half of Chidori was reflected by Chakra Shield but the other half strikes Avatar. Both men are separated by powerful energy. "Sasuke!" "Avatar!" Orochimaru stares at Avatar

rounds.name: Escape again
rounds.desc: Sakura! Cure Avatar asap! - says Yamato. Sakura quickly cures Avatar. You feel you have used too much Chakra and can't protect your life force. "Sasuke

rounds.name: Go, Sasuke
rounds.desc: Avatar has fallen too! Don't try to capture me again! I am an avenger! I will have my revenge even if I have to sacrifice myself! - says Sasuke and disappears with Orochimaru.

rounds.name: Half year
rounds.desc: You look at Sakura and say: "I'm sorry Sakura. We almost had him." Sakura shakes her head

rounds.name: New Group
rounds.desc: Don't forget about me! Four guys always are more powerful than three, and I'm not that weak anyway! - says Sai laughing. Yamato sees that your group is more harmonious and happy than ever.

rounds.name: New Dual
rounds.desc: At this time two more Akatsuki members appear. They have been to Kumokakure and captured two-tail Jinchūriki. "Don't run

rounds.name: Old Ceremony
rounds.desc: I'm not running! I have led you here on purpose, because I want to kill you in the name of the second master of Kumokakure! - says Yugito Nii. "I will complete this ceremony first.

rounds.name: Hidan won
rounds.desc: Hidan moves so fast he cripples Yugito Nii before she can see them. "It's hard to understand this religion. You can't die but you can kill others by committing suicide."

rounds.name: Gold Lover
rounds.desc: Kakuzu, where are we going? Aren't we supposed to capture Kyubi's Jinchūriki? - complains Hidan after walking such a far way. "Never mind. We'll fix flowers first

rounds.name: 12 Guardian
rounds.desc: Kakuzu, this monk is too weak. Are you sure his head is worth 3000 coins? Hidan and Kakuzu continue on their way but they must defeat the great monk who protects the temple.

rounds.name: New Train
rounds.desc: Kakashi takes Naruto for training hoping to help him discover his attributes. You already know that your attributes are Earth and Water

rounds.name: Ninja Attack
rounds.desc: Asuma, you'll lead your shinobis in the attack. All the Konohagakure shinobis will form a team to search for Akatsuki members in the Land of Fire. When you find them kill them all

rounds.name: Simple Dual
rounds.desc: Sakura and Naruto are training new Ninjutsu and you are left with Sai. "Let's go

rounds.name: Bounty Place
rounds.desc: Asuma relies on intuition. If Akatsuki kills Chiriku who guards the 12 elders

rounds.name: It is here
rounds.desc: So it's here! Izumo, attack Kotetsu! - roars Asuma and charges. Kotetsu is pierced by Izumo's Katana. "Please! It's stabbing and twisting! What to do?"

rounds.name: Undead
rounds.desc: That's an undying body! Too bad! Izumo, Kotetsu, fall back! - commands Asuma. "Teacher you will be in danger!" Shikamaru notices that Asuma charges against enemies alone

rounds.name: 1st Soldier
rounds.desc: If we are defeated or flee, Konohagakure will be in greater danger. - says Asuma. "Battles require leaders who understand sacrifice. Besides it's not so easy to kill me."

rounds.name: Got cut
rounds.desc: Asuma charges forth but his attacks have no effect. Just then Hidan cuts Asuma's face with a scythe. "Careful

rounds.name: Same Feeling
rounds.desc: What surprises Asuma is that Hidan doesn't dodge but stands his ground firmly. "Come! Let us feel the pain together!" "Aaahhh..." Asuma is burnt by flames.

rounds.name: Witchcraft
rounds.desc: Asuma sees his fire attacks have no effect and charges again. "You dare come again? Taste more pain!" Hidan stabs his own thigh. "Aaaahhh..." Asuma drops

rounds.name: To hell
rounds.desc: You are under my curse! Last time it was leg, this time- it will be heart! Die!! Hidan stabs his own heart. "No! Shadow Imitation Technique!" In the crucial moment Shikamaru stops Hidan.

rounds.name: Analysis
rounds.desc: He'd never dare use this circle. He could only use the curse after he slashed Asuma's face. Thus, he requires two things: blood and this location. - analyzes Shikamaru. "Drag him out."

rounds.name: Help me
rounds.desc: Damn it! I was found. Kakuzu, help! At the same time Asuma charges forth and beheads Hidan with his Chakra Blades. "Finally over."

rounds.name: On Purpose
rounds.desc: Kakuzu, you do it on purpose! - yells the head on its way down. Shikamaru and Asuma are totally shocked. He doesn't die even with his head chopped off? What should we do?

rounds.name: Install back
rounds.desc: Kakuzu picks Hidan's head up and attaches it to his body. "Since you are too weak alone we will fight together!" Kakuzu and Hidan attack together.

rounds.name: Trap again
rounds.desc: I will not fall for the same trick for the second time! Asuma dodges Hidan's blade but Hidan collects some of Asuma's blood that has stained the floor before. "You fall into my trap again!"

rounds.name: Asuma Death
rounds.desc: Go to hell! Hidan stabs himself through the heart. "No!" Shikamaru charges at him but it's already too late to stop him. "Ahhhh...." Asuma falls to the ground.

rounds.name: He Comes
rounds.desc: Just when Shikamaru Izumo

rounds.name: Blasted
rounds.desc: Your Rasengan explodes on Kakuzu burning a hole in his heart. But Kakuzu is still alive! "How can this be?!"

rounds.name: Immortal Group
rounds.desc: Three- tail has been captured. Akatsuki members, return all without delay! Akatsuki leader calls all of his men to return. Kakuzu and Hidan don't dare disobey. "Till the next time boy."

rounds.name: Bad news

rounds.desc: Still alive? Taste my eighth blade - Thunder Scorch Blade! Killer B charges again. "Out of the way!" Sasuke uses Sharingan to step aside but Suigetsu and others are hit

rounds.name: Invalid
rounds.desc: Sasuke opens Genjutsu eye hypnotizing Killer B. Just as Sasuke believes to have succeeded

rounds.name: Assimilation
rounds.desc: Seeing the dying Sasuke Karin rushes towards him

rounds.name: New: Amaterasu
rounds.desc: Killer B sees they are still in fight and grows enraged

rounds.name: Get Killer B
rounds.desc: Amaterasu can destroy anything. Eight-Tails didn't expect that Sasuke could use the powers of Amaterasu and receives a hit. Killer B uses Body Replacement Technique

rounds.name: Gama Mount
rounds.desc: GamaKichi uses the spirit reverse technique to summon you and Naruto to Gama Sage. All you can see are large and small Gamas! "GamaKichi how can you be in here?"

rounds.name: Senjutsu
rounds.desc: Here, you will not learn Ninjutsu, but Senjutsu! - says Fukasaku. "What is Senjutsu?" "In fight Ninjutsu uses the power of your own body

rounds.name: Sentiment
rounds.desc: If you want to use Senjutsu, you must sense the power of nature first. Only if you sense it will you be able to use it. Fukasaku will help you sense the power of nature.

rounds.name: No progress
rounds.desc: You and Naruto meditate on the ground trying to sense nature. However

rounds.name: Become Gama
rounds.desc: This Gama oil contains the essence of the power of nature. Smear it all over your body to sense the power of nature easier. However, you might turn into a Gama. - says Fukasaku.

rounds.name: Beat Again
rounds.desc: I have a drumming stick that will prevent you from transforming into a Gama. But it's very painful! Are you ready? - asks Fukasaku. "We will do whatever it takes to defeat Pain."

rounds.name: Nightmare
rounds.desc: You and Naruto apply the Gama Oil. Whenever you're in danger of turning into a Gama Fukasaku beats you with a stick. The pain goes deep into your souls

rounds.name: Feel Nature
rounds.desc: After a year of training you and Naruto finally sense the power of nature. You try to use it

rounds.name: Kill Hatred
rounds.desc: Fukasaku gives you the first book written by Jiraiya: "Ninja Integrity." Seeing how many hardships he faced all with optimism

rounds.name: Sage Skill
rounds.desc: You and Naruto slowly start to use Senjutsu together with Ninjutsu growing more powerful. "Twins of prophecy. They have already surpassed Jiraiya.

rounds.name: Invasion
rounds.desc: On the other hand Sasuke has captured Eight-Tails Jinchūriki and continues to collect Tailed Beasts. Pain is personally traveling to Konohagakure

rounds.name: Pain
rounds.desc: The time has come to bring sorrow to this world, and let them all grow! Pain has brought Six Paths and Konan with him. Konan has been sent to explore and search for Kyubi's tracks.

rounds.name: RaiKage
rounds.desc: What? Killer B was captured by Konohagakure's Uchiha clan? And he belongs to Akatsuki?? It's crucial that you go to Konohagakure and ask around.

rounds.name: Naruto?Where
rounds.desc: Pain Six Paths sends three guys to create chaos and three other to explore. "Tell me

rounds.name: Kakashi&Deva Path
rounds.desc: Kakashi encounters Pain of The Deva Path. "Lightning Cutter!" Kakashi uses the Lightning Cutter and charges at The Deva Path but is pushed away. "What?!

rounds.name: Deva Path
rounds.desc: Kakashi attacks without pause. He uses Sharingan and finally learns Pain of The Deva Path's skills. He can rebound all attacks but he can use this skill only once every five seconds.

rounds.name: Chyouza
rounds.desc: Akimichi Chyouza, cover me! - says Kakashi. "Yes master Kakashi." "Human Forest Tank!" "That's you?! Go to hell!" Kakashi throws Shurikens

rounds.name: Tell Tsunade
rounds.desc: Father! Akimichi Chyouza dies in the battle against The Deva Path and Chōji is grieving. "Chōji

rounds.name: Recall
rounds.desc: Messenger Frog! Summon Avatar and Naruto! Konohagakure needs them. - instructs Tsunade. Witnessing such a great sacrifice Tsunade is also confused. "Master Tsunade

rounds.name: Pain Secret
rounds.desc: Master Tsunade, we know Pain's secret! He is controlling those six Pain's through devices planted on corpses! His real body is not inside, but hiding somewhere nearby. - says the researcher.

rounds.name: Back!Avatar
rounds.desc: Master Fukasaku! News from Konohagakure! Pain of Six Paths is attacking Konohagakure, and the casualties are staggering! Please send Naruto and Avatar back!

rounds.name: Protect It
rounds.desc: You and Naruto learn about Pain's sudden attack on Konohagakure. You prepare yourselves and use spirit reverse technique to reach Konohagakure.

rounds.name: Pain
rounds.desc: Under Shinra Tensei attack Konohagakure loses scores of dead. Everyone suffers from staggering pain. Tsunade and Sakura do their utmost to help victims. "Avatar

rounds.name: Confront
rounds.desc: Seeing wounded Sakura and Tsunade you and Naruto are both anxious. "Sakura

rounds.name: Starting
rounds.desc: The Six Pains come together. "Take those two little Katsuyu he can tell you about Pain." "Grandmother Tsunade

rounds.name: Sage Mode
rounds.desc: Enter the Sage Mode! You enter the Sage Mode and the color of your eyes changes. "Damn! I failed to enter the Sage Mode!" Naruto fails to enter the Sage Mode.

rounds.name: Senjutsu Rasengan Combo
rounds.desc: Senjutsu - Combo Rasengan! This high-speed Rasengan bullet flies whizzing towards Pain. "Boom!" You hear the booming sound of explosion. It seems Pain of The Deva Path

rounds.name: Take Chances
rounds.desc: Senjutsu - Big Ball Rasengan! Naruto suddenly appears at Pain's side. Big Ball Rasengan pushes three Pains. "Three of them are out!"

rounds.name: SpiritSummon
rounds.desc: Summoning Technique! Pain of Animal Path summons numerous spirit beasts. "Gama Summoning Technique!" You and Naruto summon call all the Gamas from the Mount Myōboku.

rounds.name: Senjutsu Rasenshuriken
rounds.desc: Senjutsu - Rasenshuriken! You attack with Senjutsu again and Pain of The Deva Path defends with Shinra Tensei. But his defense can only defend his own Deva Path clones.

rounds.name: Konohaga 2
rounds.desc: Look! Avatar and Naruto are fighting against Pain! They are defending Konohagakure! All the surviving Konohagakure shinobis are cheering for you.

rounds.name: For peace
rounds.desc: Nagato has no choice but to use more powerful Ninjutsu. "For the sake of peace I must punish you!" "Peace? You killed our relatives and teacher. Is that what you call peace?"

rounds.name: Soreness
rounds.desc: People can only grow in pain! For peace, sacrifices are necessary. - says Pain. "People don't need your kind of peace! They need understanding and friendship!"

rounds.name: Tensei
rounds.desc: Since we won't reach understanding, I'll just have to get rid of you! Watch my Super-Ninjutsu - Chibaku Tensei! Pain uses Super-Ninjutsu to bind you and Naruto. "Finally over."

rounds.name: Will of Fire
rounds.desc: Friends! Come together, stop Pain from taking Avatar and Naruto away! Konohagakure shinobis unite to stop Pain. "What? Don't you fear death?" Pain can't understand them.

rounds.name: Transformation
rounds.desc: You and Naruto are bound by the Chibaku Tensei and can't even budge. But when you see Pain preparing for another slaughter you and Naruto finally explode

rounds.name: What is it
rounds.desc: Chibaku Tensei cannot bind the Kyubi of six-tails that has appeared and breaks down. Your eyes have already transformed into endless pitch-black abyss.

rounds.name: Formidable
rounds.desc: You and Naruto are still subconsciously matched and the remaining three Pains are slowly retreating to get a better view of the situation. However

rounds.name: Last Deva Path
rounds.desc: Hell Ninja Art - Devouring Darkness! Two Pains are immediately devoured and the last one

rounds.name: Ninja Art
rounds.desc: Only Ten Tails could have a power like this! But he is not a Jinchūriki! And Ten Tails hasn't even appeared! Pain of The Deva Path is confused. "Hell Ninja Art - Chains of Hell!"

rounds.name: Last Hit
rounds.desc: Chains of Hell bind Pain of The Deva Path and Nagato's Chakra is all used up. Kyubi Naruto repeatedly attacks Pain of The Deva Path

rounds.name: Hide Place
rounds.desc: Having defeated Pain of The Deva Path you and Naruto slowly recover. "Let's go. I can feel his hiding place." You find Nagato's hideout atop the highest tree.

rounds.name: Nagato
rounds.desc: Cough! Cough! You have found me. You really are awesome. Nagato is sitting at the top skinny and emaciated. "Nagato

rounds.name: Real peace
rounds.desc: We did it all for peace, to eliminate murder from the ninja world. But the first time I started to doubt my approach was when I noticed the connection between you and Konohagakure.

rounds.name: Shaken Will
rounds.desc: Uzumaki Nagato starts to doubt his methods of bringing peace to the world. He starts to think that Jiraiya was right and one day

rounds.name: Heavenly Life
rounds.desc: Reincarnation Technique! "Nagato!" Konan embraces Nagato. "I want to see if teacher Jiraiya's perseverance was right." - says Nagato.

rounds.name: New Konohaga
rounds.desc: Konan looks at you and Naruto and says: "Nagato has used his life force to resurrect all the people of Konohagakure. Please take up his dream

rounds.name: Hope Flower
rounds.desc: Nagato and Yahiko are dead. They meant everything for Konan but now

rounds.name: 5 Kages
rounds.desc: To defeat "Akatsuki" who dwells in darkness

rounds.name: Reconstruction
rounds.desc: Tsunade in order to save the villagers

rounds.name: New Hokage
rounds.desc: Danzō suggests: "Right now wee need a Hokage to lead us!" Shikamaru's father

rounds.name: Protests
rounds.desc: Kakashi is unanimously elected as the new Hokage but Danzō opposes: "This must be the third generation policy! In the situation like now

rounds.name: Daimyo
rounds.desc: Danzō uses the control eye of Shisui Uchiha to control Daimyo's thoughts. Land of Fire Daimyo says: "Fine! I appoint Danzō Shimura as the sixth Hokage."

rounds.name: Inheritance
rounds.desc: Seeing the ruins some villagers say: "Everything that the past Hokages left for us has been ruined." "No! Past Hokages left us something more important: spiritual power!"

rounds.name: Kumokakure
rounds.desc: What happened in here? - asks astonished Kumokakure team seeing the ruined Konohagakure. "Pain

rounds.name: Letter
rounds.desc: We request meeting with Hokage sama. We're bringing a letter from RaiKage. - say Kumokakure shinobis. "But... Hokage sama used too much power and lies unconscious.

rounds.name: Approaching
rounds.desc: No. She's not a Hokage anymore. Currently, I am the real Hokage - give the letter to me. Danzō opens the letter and reads: "Five Kage Meeting? Bounty for Sasuke? Fine!"

rounds.name: Your Worries
rounds.desc: Sasuke was branded as a wanted criminal by Kumokakure for capturing Killer B. They have sent bounty hunters after him and you're greatly worried. "Sai

rounds.name: Root
rounds.desc: Look! Sai shows his tongue. It is branded with a cursed Seal. "I mustn't say anything about Master Danzō or I will die. He has put a seal on all his followers."

rounds.name: Envoy
rounds.desc: Watch out! You pull Sakura behind you and pull out your blade. "Kumokakure

rounds.name: Jinchūriki
rounds.desc: Your master is not in danger, because Jinchūrikis must be captured alive. - says Naruto. "Are you saying the truth?" - doubt the Kumokakure men. "Yes because I am a Jinchūriki too."

rounds.name: 5 Kage Eve
rounds.desc: This new meeting is really inconvenient. - says Kankurō. "Master Gaara Master Temari

rounds.name: Set out
rounds.desc: Kurotsuchi, Akatsuchi - let's go! - yells TsuchiKage. "Old folks like me must join some Five Kage meeting. What a nuisance!" Kurotsuchi says: "Old man! If it's too much trouble just abdicate!"

rounds.name: Set out
rounds.desc: MizuKage Mei Terumī is also going. "Chōjūrō as one of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen

rounds.name: Follow Kumoka
rounds.desc: You are planning to follow Kumokakure and once you meet RaiKage

rounds.name: Ask RaiKage
rounds.desc: After entering Land of Iron you quickly find RaiKage. "Master RaiKage

rounds.name: 5 Kage Meet
rounds.desc: The Five Kage meeting begins and RaiKage is furious. Akatsuki men are all traitors from the four other villages

rounds.name: Allied Army
rounds.desc: Finally Five Kages renounce their differences and organize allied shinobi forces to deal with Akatsuki together. They mustn't allow Akatsuki to expand

rounds.name: Leader
rounds.desc: Danzō is using his Sharingan to control general Mifune from the Land of Iron. "We should allow Hokage to lead us against Akatsuki.

rounds.name: Found Out
rounds.desc: Master Danzō, can I see your right eye? It looks like Shisui Uchiha's eye. It seems that your eyes were controlling the fourth MizuKage! - says the Byakugan guard of Kirikakure.

rounds.name: Abominable
rounds.desc: Danzō,you have the guts, you bastard! You dare use such tricks at the Five Kage meeting? - asks TsuchiKage. "I will commit any crimes I must to protect the ninja world."

rounds.name: White Zetsu
rounds.desc: Suddenly a strange person appears at the Five Kage Meeting. It's Haku. "Sasuke has some to the meeting

rounds.name: Alert!
rounds.desc: General Mifune yells orders: "Red alert for the Land of Iron! Find Sasuke!" Karin detects the commotion within the Land of Iron. "Sasuke they detected us!"

rounds.name: Kumokakure
rounds.desc: Sasuke, where are running? Fourth Raikage of Kumogakure blocks Sasuke. "Eat my fist!" "Sasuke watch out!" - yells Uzumaki Karin. Suigetsu already hold his chopper in a block.

rounds.name: Tobi
rounds.desc: Avatar, Naruto! Come! Let's have a talk! "You! You dare come here!" Tobi has arrived it turns out he's the hidden master of puppets! "Don't even try to attack me

rounds.name: Kakashi Here
rounds.desc: And here's Kakashi, running so fast! - says Tobi. "Such a pity it doesn't work on me." Kakashi and Yamato have arrived. "If you want to capture Naruto you must deal with us!"

rounds.name: A story
rounds.desc: Tobi explains why Sasuke hates Konohagakure. "The Uchiha clan always relies on hate to fuel their power. You and Sasuke are natural enemies."

rounds.name: Kill 1
rounds.desc: RaiKage beats Jūgo into a pulp and thinks it's all over. But at this time Sasuke uses Sharingan

rounds.name: Self Bomb
rounds.desc: RaiKage uses his hyperspeed to capture Sasuke. His speed is second only yo Konohagakure's Gold Flash. "Thunder Bomb!" RaiKage firmly pounds at Sasuke. "This time it will be over!

rounds.name: Amaterasu
rounds.desc: Sasuke takes advantage of RaiKage and immediately uses Amaterasu. Nothing can withstand this black fire but RaiKage can! It's his Thunder Shield. "Thunder Horizon!

rounds.name: Gaara Here
rounds.desc: Just when RaiKage prepares to kill Sasuke his attack is blocked by sand. "KazeKage

rounds.name: Speak Out
rounds.desc: Those black flames used by Sasuke are Amaterasu. They can break anything. You better do something about it. I must talk with Sasuke. - says Gaara.

rounds.name: Never Giveup
rounds.desc: Sasuke, I used to be like you, fueled by hate. But ever since I met them, I have seen the light. So today, I hope you will not abandon your light.- says Gaara.

rounds.name: Close eyes
rounds.desc: I closed my eyes long ago. Now, I walk in the darkness. - says Sasuke. The death of his brother has plunged him into suffering and he has rejected light.

rounds.name: God of Valour
rounds.desc: Watch my absolute defense - Tempestuous God of Valour! - yells Sasuke. Tempestuous God of Valour cuts down a pillar of the great hall which begins to collapse. "Sasuke

rounds.name: Hunt Danzō
rounds.desc: Having found out Danzō's location Sasuke immediately leaves

rounds.name: Strikes
rounds.desc: Suiton - Yōton! MizuKage rushes towards Sasuke. "How can I kill such a handsome guy? Let me kiss you dear." "Shut up

rounds.name: Joins in
rounds.desc: TsuchiKage doesn't want to join this war but finally gives in. "Damn it

rounds.name: Tobi Here
rounds.desc: Just as Sasuke is about to die Tobi appears. "Don't even waste your powers

rounds.name: My man
rounds.desc: Because there are few who can summon the Tempestuous God of Valour's Sharingan. Also, because I arranged his arrival. Since he's my follower, it's obvious I want to save him.

rounds.name: Moon Eye
rounds.desc: What is Eye of the Moon Plan? - asks everyone. "To gather all the Nine-Tailed Beast and summon Ten Tails. To use Tsukuyomi to reflect the moonlight and become an unlimited Tsukuyomi.

rounds.name: 4th Shinobi War
rounds.desc: No way! We can as well die! Nobody wants to live in an illusion world. "Since you all refuse me I will not impose on you! I declare the fourth ninja war on you!"

rounds.name: Allied army
rounds.desc: Once Five Kages learn of the Akatsuki plan they organize allied armies. RaiKage also agrees. He doesn't want to send his younger brother

rounds.name: KillerB Here
rounds.desc: Killer B escapes using a clone and goes to master Sabu

rounds.name: Kisame shows
rounds.desc: Well, i finally found you! Killer B, I never thought you'd be hiding in such a place. My blade is already thirsty for blood. Kisame stares at Killer B as if he was a delicacy.

rounds.name: Pet of Sun
rounds.desc: You foolish bastard! Let me give you a lesson! Killer B charges with a blade in his hand but suddenly

rounds.name: Parasitism
rounds.desc: Danzō has a parasite on his body and is followed by Black and White Zetsu

rounds.name: Puppet Heart
rounds.desc: Danzō's followers use Puppet control to distract Ao and continue their escape. But soon

rounds.name: Worthless
rounds.desc: Kisame takes the raccoon down with one chop. "That's just a stupid raccoon! Not worthy of my sword." - sneers Kisame. "Ponta was just a cute little raccoon!" - roars Sabu.

rounds.name: Super Raiton
rounds.desc: Ultrasound Raiton Sword! Killer B uses his best sword technique but he can't cut through Kisame's blade. "What? Killer B's Ultrasound Raiton Sword has no effect?"

rounds.name: Light blade
rounds.desc: When Killer B sees his attack has no effect he uses the second skill. "Thunder Plow Blade!" But this one is also blocked by Kisame's sword.

rounds.name: Suck Chakra
rounds.desc: Killer B! His blade can consume Chakra! Be careful! Sabu has noticed the special properties of this blade. "Damn! Taste my power! Partial Tailed Beast transformation - Six Tails!"

rounds.name: Suiton Water Jail
rounds.desc: Suiton - Water Prison Technique! Kisame Hoshigaki creates a huge water prison to trap Killer B within. "Now I can slowly dispose of you

rounds.name: Spit out ink
rounds.desc: Killer B vomits ink and turns the water pitch black. "You really think you can escape my palm heart? My whole body can detect Chakra flow."

rounds.name: Stories
rounds.desc: Killer B, transform into a Tailed Beast! If you don't, you won't defeat Kisame. He will suck your Chakra away! - says Eight Tails. "Master Sabu is here.

rounds.name: Samehada
rounds.desc: Killer B's Chakra is too delicious so Samehada wants to use him. When Kisame prepares to chop Killer B's leg off

rounds.name: New knife
rounds.desc: Damn you, Samehada! You betray me for delicious Chakra? I will use another blade to cut him. Kisame Hoshigaki takes another blade to chop Killer B's leg off.

rounds.name: RaiKage Here
rounds.desc: Just when Kisame's blade is about to drop a Shuriken flies his way

rounds.name: Scare Kisame
rounds.desc: Attacked by RaiKage and Killer B Kisame must abandon his pursuit of Killer B and flees in panic. Otherwise

rounds.name: Ao Trouble
rounds.desc: Ao controlled by Danzō's puppets

rounds.name: Block Danzō
rounds.desc: Tobi intercepts Danzō. "Madara Uchiha you really are a nuisance!" "Haha

rounds.name: Switch
rounds.desc: Mind Body Switch Technique! Kaze uses his unique Ninjutsu but cannot capture Tobi's tracks. "He can dodge in split second. Let's attack together!" Torune joins in.

rounds.name: Parasitism
rounds.desc: Danzō, you have really gathered great followers. The quality of your forces can only be compared to the Aburame clan. Tobi hits Torune with a poison parasite.

rounds.name: Sasuke Here
rounds.desc: Tobi continues his attacks and uses space-time Ninjutsu to summon Sasuke. "Sasuke

rounds.name: Truth
rounds.desc: Danzō, was that you who incited Itachi to destroy the entire clan? - asks Sasuke. "I didn't expect Itachi would tell you. That brands him as a betrayer of Konohagakure!" - says Danzō.

rounds.name: War of Eyes
rounds.desc: Danzō removes the pouch that was hiding something on his arm and everyone sees he has 10 Sharingans! "This must be the work of Orochimaru. Danzō has changed too much."

rounds.name: Genjutsu
rounds.desc: Sasuke uses Mangekyō Sharingan and grabs Danzō. But the real Danzō is standing begind him! "Your Genjutsu isn't half as good as that of Itachi."

rounds.name: God of Valour
rounds.desc: Fuuton - Vacuum Surge! Danzō attacks Sasuke. "Tempestuous God of Valour!" Sasuke summons Tempestuous God of Valour. This absolute defense works well against the Vacuum Surge.

rounds.name: Nightmare
rounds.desc: Danzō summons a powerful spirit beast - the Beast of Nightmare. "Katon - Great Fireball Technique!" The Beast of Nightmare swallows the fireball and explodes.

rounds.name: Summoning
rounds.desc: Danzō turns and attacks again. "Fuuton - Vacuum Combo!" Seeing the incoming attack Sasuke summons a bird: "Summoning Technique!" Sasuke rides the bird and dodges.

rounds.name: Izanami
rounds.desc: Watch the power of Uchiha: Izanami! Danzō uses his special skill Izanami

rounds.name: Detect Flaw
rounds.desc: Karin observes Danzō in battle and realizes that there is a rhythm in which the eyes blink. He can use Izanami only when they are all closed! "

rounds.name: Stabs
rounds.desc: Danzō and Sasuke charge at each other with their blades. "Haha Sasuke

rounds.name: Genjutsu
rounds.desc: Danzō, you lose. I have just used a simple Genjutsu on you. I made you believe all the eyes are closed, but in fact, they aren't! - says Sasuke. "A stranger wants to join in against Uchiha?!"

rounds.name: Right eye
rounds.desc: Danzō can't believe this. But he hasn't died yet and he removes the patch from his right eye. "Come! Let us stage the ultimate jutsu duel!" He stakes all on one attack

rounds.name: Karin
rounds.desc: Danzō uses his right eye to control Karin. "If you make a step I'll kill him!" "So you're afraid to sacrifice yourself? You are afraid of death?! - laughs Sasuke.

rounds.name: Spear All
rounds.desc: For Konohagakure, for the ninja world, I cannot die yet! - roars Danzō. However just as he thinks he controls the situation

rounds.name: 4-Symbol Seal
rounds.desc: If I must die, we will all die together. Danzō's entire body creates four seals that will kill anyone they seal. "Sasuke

rounds.name: Sakura Here
rounds.desc: Just when Sasuke kills Danzō Sakura and team 10 from Konohagakure arrive. "Sasuke

rounds.name: Sudden Move
rounds.desc: If you want to join me, you must kill her! Sasuke points at Karin who hasn't succumbed to her wounds yet. Sakura secretly gathers her powers and suddenly turns around

rounds.name: Fatal Spell
rounds.desc: But Sasuke has prepared. He sends his assassins against Sakura. At this moment you and Naruto arrive. Naruto embraces Sakura. "Sasuke! How dare you send assassins against Sakura?!"

rounds.name: NaurtoSasuke
rounds.desc: Avatar, don't interfere. I will deal with Sasuke! Naruto and Sasuke have been waiting for it for ages. their Lightning Cutter and Rasengan collide and explode. Both of them are equally matched.

rounds.name: Take Sasuke
rounds.desc: Tobi notices that more and more people are arriving. If they don't run now it won't end well. "Let's go! Sasuke

rounds.name: His Will
rounds.desc: Sasuke, I finally understand your pain. I have thought of a solution: next time we meet, I will pull you into our deaths. I have the power to cause mutual destruction. - says Naruto. "YOU!"

rounds.name: Itachi's Eye
rounds.desc: Tobi and Sasuke return to their lair. "Transplant Itachi's eye to me asap! I want to show Naruto the gap between him and me! I will erase his perseverance!" Sasuke fears that Naruto will kill them both.

rounds.name: Kabuto Visit
rounds.desc: After a long long time

rounds.name: Reach a deal
rounds.desc: I need Sasuke Uchiha! What do you say? I will help you with your plan. - says Kabuto. "What do you need Sasuke for?" - asks curious Tobi. "To fulfill the desire of Orochimaru and seek the ultimate Ninjutsu."

rounds.name: Weak Up
rounds.desc: After a long time Tsunade finally regains consciousness

rounds.name: Followed
rounds.desc: RaiKage and Killer B believe they've defeated Kisame but they realize it's just his clone. The real Kisame is hiding within Samehada.He's following Eight-Tails

rounds.name: Seal Key
rounds.desc: You and Naruto are summoned by Fukasaku. "Naruto the fourth ninja war is about to begin. It will decide the fate of the ninja world. Thus

rounds.name: Frog
rounds.desc: Fukasaku tells you that the seal key is the Gerotora. "The Fourth generation Hokage wished you to master the powers of Kyubi to protect the peace of the ninja world. Devour the Gerotora!"

rounds.name: Your Secret
rounds.desc: Avatar, you are the adopted child of the Nidaime. You were named Senju Avatar. When you were born, there was a similar force sealed within you. But it's really sinister,

rounds.name: Don't lose
rounds.desc: Fukasaku informs you that nobody can help you suppress the sinister force within you. The seals on your body can only be used by the legendary Sage of the Six Paths so he urges you not to lose control.

rounds.name: Prison
rounds.desc: The Five Kage Meeting has finally started. "The current ninja world war is caused for the Jinchūrikis so we must take them into custody and protect them from being captured!" - says RaiKage.

rounds.name: Kumokakure
rounds.desc: Naruto follows Master Fukasaku's directions. He knows that on one of the islands he will meet an octopus who will teach him how to control Kyubi and open the seals.

rounds.name: Split
rounds.desc: This island looks really beautiful. Can it be the island of destiny described by Master Fukasaku? - whispers Naruto. You have already joined the war battlefield.

rounds.name: Cuttlefish
rounds.desc: The island guardian says: "Don't be afraid of anything here. The animals on this island don't attack people." But you must watch out for one thing. "Rumble rumble!"

rounds.name: Cuttlefish?
rounds.desc: One, two, three... Ten! It's got ten legs! It's not an octopus, it's a cuttlefish! - says Yamato. Kumokakure envoy says: "Speak of the devil!"

rounds.name: Killer B
rounds.desc: Go away! You bastard! Fool! Killer B appears and suppresses the cuttlefish. "Uncle you're too handsome!" Naruto notices the octopus Chakra on the uncle's back

rounds.name: The usher
rounds.desc: At this time the ship reaches the island. "Bastard

rounds.name: Control
rounds.desc: Master Killer B is Jinchūriki of the Eight-Tails. - says Motoi. When Naruto hears that Killer B can completely control his Eight-Tails he knows that he's the man they've been looking for.

rounds.name: Wrong moves
rounds.desc: Naruto has found the home of Killer B and knocks on the door: "Little brat why are you looking for me?" "Uncle

rounds.name: Kumokakure
rounds.desc: Master Motoi, Killer B is a stubborn, strange and selfish old man. He won't agree to tech me how to control the Tailed Beast. - grumbles Naruto.

rounds.name: Waterfall
rounds.desc: Motoi leads you to Killer B's practice area the Falls of Truth. "When you sit before the Falls of Truth

rounds.name: Dark Naruto
