guides.title: Energy and grudge
guides.body:
• **Energy** (red bar) is used for training. 1 point comes back every 3 minutes, a level-up refills it, and it refills to full every day at 22:00. Out of energy? Eat ramen.
• **Free ramen:** between **12:00-14:00** and again **18:00-20:00**, tap the **Noodle** stall on Home (scroll right) for full energy and grudge. (Its sign says "0:00~24:00", ignore that.)
• **Grudge** (crossed swords) is used for Spar. 1 point comes back every 2 hours. A **Hyourou-gan** refills half (Small) or all (Big) of it.
• Ramen and Hyourou-gan can be used 20 and 30 times a day, a few more per VIP level.

guides.title: Training
guides.body:
• Story stages give EXP and silver. Each stage needs a few clears before the next one opens.
• **Bosses** have 3 free tries a day, then 10 gold a try. Every boss brings its own enemies with the same strength as in the original game: lost? Make your team stronger and come back. Every boss also has a **5% chance** to drop the special card shown on its row (Graduate II = Kakashi Hatake).
• From VIP 1 and level 80, **Save time** (the EXP clock on Home) turns a Big Ramen into EXP and silver.
• **Finished the story?** Passed stages show **Finish** and can't be played again (same as the original game). But every boss has its **own** 3 free tries a day (165 bosses in total), so you can go back to any part and fight its boss again. Energy is the real limit.

guides.title: Your team and elements
guides.body:
• More team slots open as you level up (level 2, 6, 15, 30 ...) and clear story stages.
• Every card has an **element**: Water beats Fire, Fire beats Wind, Wind beats Thunder, Thunder beats Earth, Earth beats Water. Hitting the weak element does **15% more** ("Restrain" on the result screen).
• Give each ninja a weapon, armor, trinket, seal and ninjutsu. Gear makes the biggest difference.
• From level 100 the **Team 2** tab opens: build a second line-up (it may use the same cards) and press **Activate** to fight with it.

guides.title: Getting cards and gear
guides.body:
• **Recruit** (Shop): the blue recruit is free every 2 days, the purple one every 3 days (like the original). Every 10th purple pull without a 5-star card is a sure 5-star (the window counts down: "Recruit N more will get one").
• Shop gift bags give gear, and their description tells you the stars (a 3-star bag gives 2 to 4 stars, a 4-star bag 3 to 5).
• **Advance** in the Base upgrades 5-star level-50 gear (50 000 silver).

guides.title: Fighting other players
guides.body:
• **Spar** (bottom bar): win EXP, silver and war achievements.
• **Arena** (Home, from level 25): climb the ranks for daily silver and reputation. 25 challenges a day (+1 per VIP level); after every 3 there is a 10-minute wait, or pay 30 gold to skip it. Claim the daily reward with the **Claim** button on your own row in the Compete list (once a day, until midnight). Ranks 1-1000 also get a **ladder prize** with it (gear, a seal, gold or silver: see the Arena Rules); it goes to your backpack. Spend reputation in the **Exchange** tab (some items once ever, pills twice a day).
• **Battles** (Home): 25 chapters of 7 rounds, the 7th is the chapter boss. **Ranking > Achievement** pays a reward every 7 floors.
• **News**: the Battle tab shows who sparred or plundered you (press **Revenge** to fight back), the Friend tab shows messages from friends.
• **War** and **Border war**: fight for your nation. War is open all day; the clock shows the time until midnight. After every 3 attacks you wait 10 minutes (or pay 30 gold). **Autoplay** (50 gold) attacks for you for the rest of the day, even when you are offline. National treasure: 1 hour between raids (15 gold skips it).
• **Border war** (Boundary Monument): taunt (20 gold) or wander (2500 silver) at another nation's monument, or clear enemies from yours, **every day from 12:00 to 15:00 EST** (New York time: 18:00-21:00 in the Netherlands in winter). The **Yesterday** ranking pays out the next day: the top 3 defenders get a 1-in-10,000 shinobi card + 10 Super Ninja Pills, the top 10 attackers 500 gold.
• **Akatsuki**: after you leave one, you wait **2 hours** before you can join or found another.
• Real players fight with their **whole team**. Bots bring about as many cards as you do, and every enemy card's stats vary a little each fight. Watching a fight or pressing **Skip** always gives the same result.

guides.title: Cross-server battle
guides.body:
• Find the **Cross** building on Home (scroll the map to the right).
• **Until Friday 8 pm:** buy a ticket for 500 gold. The arena top 20 get in for free.
• **Saturday 8-9 pm:** challenge the players above you on the ladder. Every position earns points each second, and higher positions earn more.
• **Inspire:** 200 gold for +10% attack and defence for 5 minutes.
• **Merit tab:** rankings and the **point shop** (24 000 to 850 000 points). Points carry over to the next week.

guides.title: Base buildings
guides.body:
• **Advance**: upgrade gear (see chapter 4).
• **Ninja Test** (level 45): 15 stages a day with your 4 and 5-star ninjas. Stages 5, 10 and 15 have boss chests (free, 160 and 250 gold).
• **Breakthrough** for God cards, and **Pets** from level 150. Every God card can break through: won fights (training stages, bosses, Spar, Arena) can drop **fragments of your own God cards** (Backpack > Fragments). Shard Rush days give double.

guides.title: Events
guides.body:
• Check the **Event** menu and the **Daily Task** list every day for free rewards.
• **Events rotate every week**, so you see all of them in 7 days: days 1-2 God of Wealth, Gold spending rewards and the Time-limited GiftPack; days 3-4 Flower Worship, God Recruit and Group purchase; days 5-7 Hot Treasure, a festival and (days 5-6) the Total-recharge gift; day 7 God Recruit again. **Shard Rush** (double God card fragments from fights) on days 4 and 7. Diligence, Daily spending, Lottery, Recharge streak and the Month card run all week. Each event shows its own countdown.
• **Festivals** (one each week, in the rotation): win fights for festival items (Christmas Caps and Trees, or Fireworks and Balloons for the Anniversary) and trade them in the Event menu for rare cards.
• **Sign-in** (Event menu): log in on days in a row for ramen, Hyourou-gan and silver; from day 7 also 20 gold a day. Missing a day starts again at day 1.
• **Lottery** and **Wheel of Fortune** open at level 10. Lottery: 50 gold a ticket, drawn every day at 20:30. Prizes: 1st an Ultimate Shinobi Card (5 stars), 2nd a Five-Star card, 3rd a Four-Star card.
• In the rotation: **God of Wealth** (invest gold in 8 steps, always get a bit more back), **Flower Worship** (every dollar topped up gives a rose; give a goddess her roses for a rare card), **Month card** (a 4.99 or 9.99 top-up gives 60 or 120 gold a day for 30 days).

guides.title: Super Ninja, bosses and VIP
guides.body:
• **Super Ninja** (Home): open **all day, every day** for now. Every hour a new god card is the prize. Gold draw 300 (10 for 2800) gives 4-5 star cards, every 10th draw is a sure 5-star, and you get 1 free draw a day. Every draw is 10 points; **every hour** 1st place wins that god card, 2nd-3rd get 300 gold, 4th-10th 100 gold (you need at least 50 points). When the hour ends the next card starts right away and the prizes arrive in your **Awards** chest.
• **World Boss** (Event menu): an Akatsuki member invades every day from **14:00 to 14:30**: 10 hits, then a short wait. Hit it for reputation and spend that in its shop. A new boss comes after each one falls (Kakuzu, Sasori, Deidara, Hidan ...).
• **Ninja Treasure** (chest on Home, left side): Explore for gold to win the 9 prizes on the board (35, 70, 300 ... gold, rising). Every board hides one big card from **Top Rewards**; a new board comes every 2 hours, or press Refresh (100 gold).
• **Awards** chest (Home, right side): gifts the server owner sends you and event prizes (Super Ninja). Press **Claim**; they stay 7 days.
• Free top-ups (one a day) raise your VIP, up to **VIP 23**. Badges stop at VIP18, but your real level counts.

guides.title: God cards: evolve and fragments
guides.body:
• **Evolve** (Home, bottom row, **evolve**): put in the **attack card** and the **defense card** of the same five-star ninja (both out of your team), pay **100 Development Dan**, and you get that ninja's **God card**. Rebirth and Sage Growth carry over (the higher of the two), and the Super Ninja Pills you used on the two cards come back. The wiki shows on every God card whether it can be evolved.
• Not enough Development Dan? Pressing **Evolute** says "Insufficient evolution pills". Tapping the purple pill in the middle only shows what the pill is for.
• **Development Dan** comes from the Shop, the Arena exchange (15 000 reputation, 2 a day), the monthly sign-in, the Akatsuki mall, the gold spending and top-up gifts and Hot Treasure (the wiki's Development Dan page lists them all).
• **God card fragments** drop from won fights (more on Shard Rush days). They are used for **Breakthrough**, and 50 of them make a new copy of that God card (Backpack > Fragments).

guides.title: Play on the public server (easiest)
guides.body:
The public server **ninjaonline** is online day and night (it runs in the cloud, not on someone's PC).
The game file for it is **`HelloBro-ninjaonline.xapk`** on the Releases page: https://github.com/Djassie18698/hello-bro-revival/releases/tag/tailscale-play
**On a PC (BlueStacks 5):**
1. Install **BlueStacks 5**: https://www.bluestacks.com
2. Download **`HelloBro-ninjaonline.xapk`** and drag it onto the BlueStacks window. Wait until it's installed.
3. Open Hello Bro. When the account window shows, tap **PLAY**. The game remembers this device.
4. Tap **Confirm** if it asks to download an update, press **START**, then pick your nation and your ninja.
**On a phone or tablet:** see chapter 2.

guides.title: Android phone or tablet
guides.body:
The surest way is **from a PC with a USB cable** (USB debugging). Phone XAPK installer apps often fail, or install the game without its data (then it shows a black screen or closes at start).
**A. Turn on USB debugging (one time)**
1. On the phone: **Settings > About phone** (Samsung: **About phone > Software information**). Tap **Build number** 7 times (Xiaomi: tap **MIUI / OS version**). Enter your PIN if asked: "You are now a developer".
2. Go back to **Settings > Developer options** (Samsung: at the bottom of Settings; others: **System > Developer options**) and turn on **USB debugging**.
**B. Install**
1. On the PC, download these 2 files from the Releases page into **one folder**: **`HelloBro-ninjaonline.xapk`** and **`INSTALL-WITH-USB.bat`**. (Own server? Use your `HelloBro-for-<address>.xapk` instead.)
2. Uninstall any old Hello Bro on the phone. Close BlueStacks on the PC.
3. Connect the phone with a USB cable (a data cable, not a charge-only one). The phone asks **"Allow USB debugging?"**: tick **Always allow** and tap **Allow**.
4. Double-click **`INSTALL-WITH-USB.bat`**. The first time it installs Android's USB tool (adb): close the window when it says so and double-click it again.
5. It installs the game and copies its data. When it says it's done, open Hello Bro on the phone and tap **PLAY**.
6. Google Play Protect says "unsafe app blocked"? Tap **More details > Install anyway**.
**No cable?** On Android 11+ it also works over Wi-Fi: when the .bat finds no phone, type **W** and follow its steps (Developer options > **Wireless debugging**, phone and PC on the same Wi-Fi).
**Phone only runs 64-bit apps** (Samsung S25/S26 Ultra, Pixel 7 and newer)? The normal install fails there: use the VPhoneOS way in chapter 9.
**No PC?** Try an XAPK installer app (for example *XAPK Installer* or *APKPure*). If it fails or the game shows a black screen at start, use the USB way above.
Done? You can turn USB debugging off again.

guides.title: Your account and another device
guides.body:
Tapping **PLAY** makes an account tied to that device.
To keep it when you switch device: tap **Change** on the start screen > **Login with Gumptech** > **Signup**, and choose a name and password.
On the new device, use **Login with Gumptech** > **Login** with the same name and password.
Lost your account after reinstalling? Without that name and password the game makes a new account, so sign up before you switch.

guides.title: Your own server (solo, or with friends)
guides.body:
Want your own world? The server runs on your Windows PC.
1. On the GitHub page: **Code > Download ZIP**, then unzip it (for example to `Desktop\HelloBroServer`).
2. From the Releases page, download **`HelloBro-base-host-your-own.xapk`** into that folder.
3. Double-click **`HOST-MY-SERVER.bat`**. Press Enter to play on your own PC, or type the address your friends will use (your Tailscale IP, for example). It makes **`HelloBro-for-<address>.xapk`**.
4. Double-click **`START-SERVER.bat`** and keep the window open. The control panel opens in your browser.
5. Drag your `HelloBro-for-….xapk` onto BlueStacks. Give the same file to friends who play on your server.
Full guide: https://github.com/Djassie18698/hello-bro-revival/blob/main/docs/HOST-YOUR-OWN-SERVER.md

guides.title: Updates
guides.body:
• **Game updates** come in by themselves: when the game says **"confirm update?"**, tap **Confirm**.
• **Hosting your own server?** Close the server window, double-click **`UPDATE.bat`**, then start the server again. Your save is never touched.
• Can't connect after updating your server? Run **`HOST-MY-SERVER.bat`** again and install the new .xapk (see #discord on Discord).

guides.title: Friends in another house
guides.body: They can't reach your PC directly. The easy way is **Tailscale** (free): you and your friends join the same Tailscale network, and you make the game file with your Tailscale IP in chapter 4, step 3.

guides.title: Problems
guides.body:
• *"Network error" / stuck on loading*: the server is offline, or the game file was made for another address. Public server: ask in #discord on Discord. Your own server: is `START-SERVER.bat` still open? After an update, make a new game file (chapter 5).
• *Black screen or crash at start (phone)*: the game's data (.obb) wasn't copied. Install it with the USB way (chapter 2). Still black after that? Clear the game's data: Settings > Apps > Hello Bro > Storage > **Clear data**.
• *"This app was built for an older version of Android"*: tap **OK**, the game works.
• *Screen sideways in BlueStacks*: the game is portrait. Turn off forced landscape for the app in BlueStacks settings.

guides.title: Bugs and help
guides.body:
• **Questions:** #discord on Discord. Say: public server or your own, BlueStacks or phone, and what you see on screen.
• **Bugs:** #discord on Discord, or on GitHub: https://github.com/Djassie18698/hello-bro-revival/issues
• **What's new:** #discord on Discord

guides.title: Phones that only run 64-bit apps (S25 / S26 Ultra, Pixel 7+)
guides.body:
The game is a 32-bit app from 2015, and some new phones can't run 32-bit apps at all ("app not compatible" or *NO_MATCHING_ABIS*). You can still play it there inside a **virtual Android 7 phone**. Found by **polterslave**, tested on a Samsung S26 Ultra: thank you!
1. On the phone, download **`HelloBro-ninjaonline.xapk`** (the Download button on https://ninjaonlinereborn.com).
2. Install **ZArchiver** from the Play Store (free). Open the .xapk with it and extract it. You get **`com.hello.bro.yo.apk`** and a folder **`Android/obb/com.hello.bro.yo`** (the game's data, about 110 MB).
3. Install **VPhoneOS** from the Play Store (free) and create a virtual phone with **Android 7**. It looks complicated, but it's quick.
4. Inside the virtual phone, import the **.apk** and install it, then import the **obb folder** so it ends up at **Android/obb/com.hello.bro.yo** there too.
5. Open Hello Bro inside the virtual phone and tap **PLAY**. Done!

guides.title: I can't connect to the server after an update
guides.body:
If you host your own server and the game can't connect after you updated it, make a new game file for your server:
1. Update your server folder (run **UPDATE.bat**), then start the server again.
2. Double-click **HOST-MY-SERVER.bat** in your server folder.
3. Type your server address when it asks (the same one your friends use, for example your Tailscale IP), or press Enter for your own PC.
4. It makes a new game file. Install it on every phone or emulator that plays on your server (uninstall the old game first if it won't install over it).
5. Open the game and tap **Confirm** if it asks to download an update.

guides.title: The game won't install on my phone or tablet
guides.body:
Install it from a PC with a USB cable: turn on **USB debugging** on the phone, put **HelloBro-ninjaonline.xapk** and **INSTALL-WITH-USB.bat** (both on the Releases page) in one folder and double-click the .bat. Step by step: #discord on Discord, chapter 2. That works on every phone, also Android 14 and 15.
Own server? Android 14 and newer refuse game files made before 2 Nov 2026: run **UPDATE.bat**, make a new game file with **HOST-MY-SERVER.bat**, and install that one the same way.

guides.title: How do I update my own server?
guides.body:
1. Close the server window.
2. Double-click **UPDATE.bat** in your server folder. No UPDATE.bat? Download the folder again from GitHub (Code > Download ZIP).
3. Start the server again with **START-SERVER.bat**, and tap **Confirm** in the game if it asks to update.
4. If the game can't connect afterwards, see question 1.
Playing on the public server? You only need step 3: tap **Confirm** when the game asks.

guides.title: I lost my account after reinstalling
guides.body: The game links your account to your device. To move it, first tap **Change** > **Login with Gumptech** > **Signup** on the old device and pick a name and password. Then use **Login** with them on the new device. Without a name and password, a reinstall makes a new account.

guides.title: Is it really free?
guides.body: Yes. Top-ups cost nothing and still raise your VIP level. On the public server you can top up once a day; on your own server as often as you like (the owner of a server can change this in its control panel). Never pay anyone for gold, accounts or items.

guides.title: Is the public server always on?
guides.body: Yes. Since 3 Nov 2026 **ninjaonline** runs in the cloud, so it's online day and night, also when the owner's PC is off. Now and then it restarts for an update (a minute or so). Your progress is saved and backed up every 6 hours.

guides.title: Can I add gold and items myself?
guides.body:
Yes, on the public server for now. Open **http://ninjaonline.duckdns.org:18080/admin** in a browser (PC or phone), type your in-game name under **Players** and click it. Then use **Resources** (gold, silver, energy, level ...), **Give** (one card or item) or **Team editor**. Close the game and open it again to see what you added.
Only change **your own** account: leave other players alone.

guides.title: Black screen when I open the game again
guides.body:
After quitting, newer Android (14 and 15) kept part of the game running, and the next start stayed black. Fixed in the game file of 3 Nov 2026: download **HelloBro-ninjaonline.xapk** again and install it over the old one (your account stays; own server: run **UPDATE.bat** and **HOST-MY-SERVER.bat** for a new game file).
Still have the old file? Go to *Settings > Apps > Hello Bro > Force stop* and open the game again. Clearing the cache is not needed.

guides.title: "This app isn't compatible" / my phone only runs 64-bit apps
guides.body:
Hello Bro is a game from 2015 and its engine is a **32-bit** app. Some new phones (Samsung S25 / S26 Ultra, Google Pixel 7 and newer) can't run 32-bit apps at all, so the normal install fails there. A 64-bit version can't be made: the game's source code was never released, only the finished app.
**But you can still play on that phone**, inside a free virtual Android 7 phone (found by **polterslave**, works on the S26 Ultra):
1. On the phone, download **`HelloBro-ninjaonline.xapk`** (the Download button on https://ninjaonlinereborn.com).
2. Install **ZArchiver** from the Play Store (free). Open the .xapk with it and extract it. You get **`com.hello.bro.yo.apk`** and a folder **`Android/obb/com.hello.bro.yo`** (the game's data, about 110 MB).
3. Install **VPhoneOS** from the Play Store (free) and create a virtual phone with **Android 7**. It looks complicated, but it's quick.
4. Inside the virtual phone, import the **.apk** and install it, then import the **obb folder** so it ends up at **Android/obb/com.hello.bro.yo** there too.
5. Open Hello Bro inside the virtual phone and tap **PLAY**. Done!
Other ways: **BlueStacks** on a PC (steps in #discord on Discord), or another phone or tablet.

guides.title: Is there an iPhone / iPad version?
guides.body: No. Only the Android game survived, so on Apple devices you can't play. Use an Android phone or tablet, or **BlueStacks** on a Windows PC.

guides.title: Something is broken
guides.body: Post it in #discord on Discord with a screenshot and what you did. Fixes are announced in #discord on Discord.

Sage Growth extra stones, the Double EXP Pill and pet training stars work like the original again; bug reports are now a forum on Discord.

Events rotate every week by themselves, so every event shows up in 7 days (Super Ninja twice a day for 4 hours, a new god card every hour), and every God card can break through: won fights drop fragments of your own God cards, double on Shard Rush days; the owner sets the rates and the rotation in the Server Manager.

Website: the strongest players live from the server, a page per player that shows where their attack and defence come from (cards, gear, chains, Eight Gates, pets...), Today in the game (god card of the hour, ramen and energy times), a players-online graph, a team calculator in the wiki, a page per card, gear, stage and guide so Google finds them, short links /download, /install, /discord, and the address contact@ninjaonlinereborn.com

Breakthrough costs and bonuses like the original screens (10 fragments and 60 000 / 250 000 silver for +1, +1% trigger and +2% restrain a level). The login screen says Ninja Online Reborn, and chosen players get a glowing name (colour and sparkles picked in the control panel) on Home and in the No.1 Shinobi list.

Training and Battles exactly like the original: every boss brings its own enemies with their real strength (checked against 15 old screenshots), the story wheel uses the game's own odds; more original numbers from the game's own tables (Lucky Wheel, sage growth, border war, change country, free recruits every 3 / 2 days, a sure 5-star every 10th purple pull); war Auto-Attack works (also offline) with the original war cooldown; reincarnation shows in fights; VIP up to 23.

Late-game test round at level 100: cards stop at level 50 so Reincarnate works, Evolve only takes a real attack + defense pair and gives training pills back, country war texts, original prices and gifts for country officials, Akatsuki log text.

Elements the right way round, pets claw more often, the public server no longer restarts at night, the tutorial switched off for everyone (game update 28.0.35), English button texts (28.0.36), real strength in the Spar and Plunder list. A weekend test round with a brand-new character.

The public server ninjaonline now runs 24/7 in the cloud (no longer on a home PC). Phones install the game from a PC with USB debugging + INSTALL-WITH-USB.bat. The ninja you pick at the start is the one you get (everyone got Shikamaru), the Starter gift no longer pops up after every level-up, a tidier folder with only the .bat files on top.

New event Limited Super Ninja ("Super Ninja" on Home): every god card takes a turn, a new one every hour, with a points ranking and prizes. Big test round with no new bugs found. The second team (Team 2, from level 100), battle reports and friend messages in News, all 25 Battles chapters with floor rewards, the Arena Exchange with its real limits, Akatsuki leader tools, war rankings, an Award Center to send gifts from the control panel, the Anniversary festival, daily task chests like the original, War open all day, the real silver on the Victory screen, real login (play as guest or sign up to move phones), the public server ninjaonline, and new events (Sign-in streak, God of Wealth, Month card, Flower Worship). Items, gift packs and VIP gifts give what their text says. The Discord bot now shows as online.

The cross-server battle, elements in fights (Water > Fire > Wind > Thunder > Earth > Water), real players fight with their real team, holiday and limited events (Christmas, New Year, God Recruit, Hot Treasure, Lottery and more), card stats exactly like the game, the team builder and one control panel, Server Manager, rebirth up to 8, sage growth with the original chances, a Join Discord button in the game's Settings.
